Azuad Islam Ruhan is an undergraduate researcher in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Metropolitan University, Sylhet, Bangladesh. His research focuses on machine learning for behavioral prediction, natural language processing for Bangla, and educational technology for rural learners. An active competitive programmer with more than 1,000 solved problems, he is currently working on his undergraduate thesis, which draws on Cortical Labs' work on biological computing. He plans to pursue graduate studies in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Golam Mostofa Naeem is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Metropolitan University, Bangladesh. His research interests are machine learning, natural language processing, explainable artificial intelligence, and deep learning, with a focus on AI methods that are interpretable and reliable enough to be used on real problems. Alongside his research, he teaches and works with students on academic projects.
